summary.en: Choose visibility for classes and members and protect state behind a narrow interface.
summary.bn: ক্লাস আর মেম্বার কোথা থেকে ব্যবহার করা যাবে ঠিক করো এবং ডেটা আড়ালে রাখো।

notes: Access rules shown follow Java 17; private access also includes nested classes in the same top-level nest.

examples.title: Read private state through a method
examples.explanationHtml: Main cannot directly name the private balance field of this separate top-level Account. getBalance supplies the permitted read.

examples.title: Reject an invalid deposit
examples.explanationHtml: The public operation returns false before changing private state, so balance remains zero.

examples.title: Package access in one unnamed package
examples.explanationHtml: Neither class has a package declaration. The package-private field is accessible because both types share the unnamed package.

examples.title: A public method on a package-private class
examples.explanationHtml: The count is hidden. The class itself has package access, while its methods form the interface available to accessible callers.

practice.title: Read a hidden roll
practice.statementHtml: Input: roll from 1 to 999. Initialise a private Student roll in a constructor and print it through a public getter.
hints: The getter returns the private field.

practice.title: Controlled deposit
practice.statementHtml: Input: an integer amount from -100 to 10000. Deposit it into an empty Account. Print success as true or false, then balance on the next line.
hints: Reject nonpositive amounts before writing balance.

practice.title: Bounded counter interface
practice.statementHtml: Input: n from 0 to 20. Call a public increment method n times on a Counter whose value is private. Print the value through a method.
hints: Keep count inaccessible to direct callers.

practice.title: Withdraw without exposing state
practice.statementHtml: Input: opening balance from 0 to 10000 and withdrawal from -100 to 10000. Withdraw only when positive and no greater than the balance. Print success and remaining balance on separate lines.
hints: A failed operation must leave state unchanged.

quiz.prompt: What can the public getter reveal after a valid deposit?
quiz.explanation: deposit changes private state and the getter returns the saved balance 30.

quiz.prompt: Does a rejected deposit change the hidden balance?
quiz.explanation: Zero is rejected, so the earlier balance 20 stays unchanged.

quiz.prompt: Can Main read this package-private field in the same unnamed package?
quiz.explanation: Package-private access permits this same-package read, producing 7.

options: No keyword; omit the access modifier
quiz.explanation: default is not an access modifier for ordinary fields.

quiz.prompt: Which access level should an Account balance usually have?
quiz.explanation: Private state forces changes through operations that can enforce balance rules.

quiz.prompt: Which ordinary top-level class modifiers are allowed for access?
quiz.explanation: Top-level types cannot use private or protected access; nested types have other choices.

quiz.prompt: Does protected allow every unrelated class in another package to access a member?
quiz.explanation: Outside the package, protected access depends on subclass context and receiver restrictions.

quiz.prompt: Does import bypass a private field restriction?
options: No; import only helps name a type
quiz.explanation: Visibility is checked independently of whether a type name is imported.

quiz.prompt: Why can a public method on an inaccessible class still be unusable to an outside caller?
options: The declaring type also has to be accessible
The return value is always private
quiz.explanation: A public member does not make its package-private declaring type public.

quiz.prompt: What UML symbol commonly marks a private attribute?
quiz.explanation: Minus means private, plus public, hash protected and tilde package access.

quiz.prompt: Do campus.model and campus.model.internal share package-private access?
options: Yes; every dotted subpackage shares access
quiz.explanation: A common package-name prefix does not merge access boundaries.

keyPoints.en: private members are accessible inside their enclosing top-level class nest.
keyPoints.bn: private মেম্বার তার ঘিরে থাকা টপ-লেভেল ক্লাসের নেস্টের ভেতরে ব্যবহার করা যায়।

keyPoints.en: Package-private means no access modifier is written.
keyPoints.bn: কোনো অ্যাক্সেস মডিফায়ার না লিখলে package-private হয়।

keyPoints.en: protected grants package access plus restricted access from subclasses elsewhere.
keyPoints.bn: protected একই প্যাকেজে অ্যাক্সেস দেয়, আর বাইরে সাবক্লাসে বিশেষ নিয়মে দেয়।

keyPoints.en: A public member still needs an accessible enclosing type.
keyPoints.bn: public মেম্বার ব্যবহার করতেও তার বাইরের টাইপে অ্যাক্সেস থাকতে হয়।

keyPoints.en: Private fields let methods enforce valid changes.
keyPoints.bn: private ফিল্ড রাখলে মেথড দিয়ে পরিবর্তনের নিয়ম মানানো যায়।

examQuestions.question: Build the Java visibility table for same class, same package, subclass elsewhere and unrelated class elsewhere.
examQuestions.answerHtml: private allows the enclosing top-level nest. Package-private allows the same package. protected allows the same package and qualified subclass access elsewhere. public allows all contexts when the enclosing type is accessible. Across packages, a protected instance receiver must obey the subclass restriction.

examQuestions.question: Explain why a public balance field weakens an Account design.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Callers can assign a negative balance without using validation. A private field with deposit and withdraw operations gives one place to preserve the nonnegative rule.

examQuestions.question: Why do these single-file examples not demonstrate cross-package protected access by execution?
examQuestions.answerHtml: They place their top-level classes together in the unnamed package. The separate-package rule must be reasoned about using a folder diagram and access table.
